subject.title: feat: expose model pricing to plugins via runtime.usage API

question: Should OpenClaw expose the current `resolveModelCostConfig` and `estimateUsageCost` helper signatures through `api.runtime.usage`, or should the plugin SDK pricing surface be narrowed before release?
rationale: This PR adds a public plugin SDK namespace, and automation cannot choose the permanent compatibility contract for external plugins.

options.title: Accept Current API And Repair Coverage
options.body: Keep the two-helper `api.runtime.usage` shape, then update lazy reflection, add the reflection test case, and regenerate the SDK API baseline before merge.

options.title: Narrow The Pricing DTO First
options.body: Reshape the namespace into a smaller plugin-owned pricing DTO/helper contract before release so external plugins do not depend on internal helper signatures.

options.title: Defer Core SDK Surface
options.body: Leave the PR open or close it until maintainers decide that pricing estimates should be exposed through a different plugin or SDK seam.

recommendation.title: Accept Current API And Repair Coverage
recommendation.body: Keep the two-helper `api.runtime.usage` shape, then update lazy reflection, add the reflection test case, and regenerate the SDK API baseline before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to the PR and has the clearest history on usage-cost reporting, making him the best owner for the pricing API decision.
